context: Arrested char.teddy_arce calls Maureen Kehoe from the precinct payphone.

lines.speaker: char.maureen_kehoe
lines.text: Kehoe. Don't say anything. Not even 'hello'. Which precinct?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Midtown Central. Kearney's desk. He's pretending not to know me.

lines.speaker: char.maureen_kehoe
lines.text: Fifty now, fifty when you're out. Sit. Look bored. I'll be there in twenty.
